title: Antique
description: Deepak is a middle-aged man, who runs an antique shop, owned by her bedridden wife. Each day of the business, Deepak encounters new and unique customers whom he blackmails and takes advantage of. But, this illicit affair tends to turn sour when his wife starts doubting his actions and intentions.

title: A Moment, A Kiss, A Forever Love
description: After a divorce triggered by her husband's infidelity, Jessie Rowe forms a bond with Erickson Gray, a model, hoping to fulfill her greatest desire—a child of her own. Just as Jessie begins to develop feelings for Erickson, her vengeful ex-husband makes a move to complicate things.

title: A Girl, a Guy, a Space Helmet
description: Walter Kipling is an introverted yet determined inventor at Zspace Industries with a dream of being a hero in space exploration. When he's passed over for a fellowship on an upcoming launch in favor of the beautiful Katherine White, Walter returns to his daily grind in the math lab. But when Shuttle 9 goes missing, Walter and his childhood solar-powered space helmet may be Katherine's only chance for coming back to Earth alive. Walter will have one desperate last chance to be the "somebody" he dreamed.

title: A+
description: Alex Fellar is a bright and articulate--yet impoverished--college student. But fate intervenes, when Alex realizes the key to financial freedom lies simply in doing the work that nobody has time to do--writing term papers.

title: A Goat for a Vote
description: The best way to understand our society is to look at one's children. Three students in Kenya compete to become the next school president. Winning the election not only gives them the possibility for power and respect, but guarantees them a future in Kenyan society. Magdalene, has to prove herself in a boy dominated school which has never been led by a girl. She has the impossible task to unite all girls in her fight for equal rights. Harry, from a poor family, hopes to win so he can take care of his family in the future. He struggles against the popular Said who is a natural born leader with a disarming smile.

title: The Comeback S1-S3
description: An ex A-list celebrity attempts to rekindle the flame of her once prominent acting career with nothing but a camera crew and some determination.

Their unimaginable fears are realized when things inside the house take a supernatural and sinister turn. Ben and his family flee for their lives, but it is too late. The house isn't finished with them, trapping the family in its labyrinth. The Williams must come together as never before to fight for their family, their lives and to escape.

title: A House on a Hill
description: Harry is an irascible, aging architect trying to achieve the dream of building his masterwork. A wealthy young couple has commissioned Harry to design and rebuild a house he once owned that had burned down. Though reluctant at first, he eventually takes on the assignment and develops a new sense of purpose when his ex-wife Mercedes gives him her blessing. Harry soon realizes that the work has tapped into the vigor and promise of his youth. In the meantime Gaby has been hired to make a documentary about Harry--her project helps to reveal a complex man who, because of personal tragedy, has never attained the greatness most people felt he was destined for.

title: A Gesture and a Word
description: At age 50, musician and poet, Rob Morsberger was diagnosed with terminal brain cancer - and it came at the high point in his career. After 25 years in the music business, critics were starting to compare his songwriting to Randy Newman, Tom Waits and even Stephen Foster. Finally, it was all starting to come together. Rather than succumb to the shockingly grim news that he had 18 to 20 months to live, Rob used it as fuel to launch into the most prolific period of his songwriting career - determined to utilize whatever remained of this physical and spiritual resources to explore through words and music the nature of life, the inevitability of death and the infinite magic in the detail of a single moment. This musical legacy was for all to hear but it was especially for his 8 year old son so he could know and remember his father. "A Gesture and a Word" is a gentle portrait of the greatest songwriter you never heard of - a man who exemplified the phrase, Ars Longa - Vita Brevis (Art is Long - Life is Short).

title: A Mãe Traída é a Herdeira Divina
description: Lena é a herdeira do poder divino de Atena. Uma figura materna acolhedora e movida pela compaixão, mas que, por trás da doçura, esconde uma presença firme e imponente. Ela foi a Suprema Estrategista da lendária Ordem de Aegis, mas abandonou o poder após um incêndio devastador, há vinte e cinco anos. Naquele dia, ela arriscou a vida para salvar sete crianças e as criou como seus próprios filhos. Por décadas, Lena manteve sua identidade em segredo. Mas, no dia do seu aniversário de cinquenta anos, os sete filhos pelos quais ela sacrificou tudo são manipulados por suas famílias biológicas e se voltam contra ela, acusando-a de sequestro. Traída e de coração partido, Lena desperta o poder que estava adormecido havia tanto tempo. Não mais disposta a sofrer em silêncio, ela quer retomar o poder, revelar a verdade e lembrar ao mundo e a seus filhos por que um dia foi temida como a líder destinada a comandar.

description: A gullible optimist tries to join an immortality cult after finding he can't have children.

title: S.O.B.
description: A successful movie director makes the most expensive film in his career and it becomes a huge flop. He tries to salvage his career by reshooting the film as an erotic production, where its family-friendly star takes her top off.

title: Plan B
description: A bookkeeper who thinks she killed three mobsters is subsequently promoted by her boss to be a hitman.

title: Lady B.
description: Venice, July 1909. A boy from south of Italy, just rejected from the Naval Academy because of thoracic insufficiency and a slight squint, unexpectedly rescues a British pretty widow's life, Lady B. The two are joined only by a hopeless vitality and an unconsciousness desire. The lady will decide to spend with that boy a whole week of passion in which she'll teach him everything about dancing and seducing. That boy will become, in few years, the greatest mute film icon: Rudolph Valentino.

title: Jae-seok's B&B Rules!
description: Yu Jae-seok ventures into running a B&B alongside Lee Kwang-soo, Byeon Woo-seok, and Ji Ye-eun. The staff and guests create memorable moments filled with laughter and genuine connections.

title: B2: Stealth at War
description: The most expensive and specialized airplane ever built, the B2 Stealth bomber carries a price tag of more than two billion dollars. Highly effective and extremely technically advanced, it has been an integral part of the Air Force arsenal for the past 20 years. From a Cold War scrap heap candidate, to the go-to bomber in the 2011 strike against Qaddafi's army in Libya, "Spirit" has seen its share of trials and triumphs. Join us as we detail how this secret weapon evolved to overcome critics, espionage, and even tragedy, to change the shape of aviation forever.

title: D.B. Cooper: Where Are You?!
description: It follows the 50-year quest to find Cooper, the man who hijacked a Northwest Airlines passenger jet in November 1971 and escaped with $200,000.

title: Battle B-Daman
description: Yamato Delgado who acquires the legendary B-Daman known as Cobalt Blade, joins his friends using the sport of B-Daman to fight against the evil Shadow Alliance. This show takes place in the B-DaWorld, where its inhabitants vary.

title: B-Side
description: When an underground radio DJ makes fun of a fading pop star who happens to listen to his show, the two begin an unlikely relationship. But difficult life and career crossroads jeopardize their idyllic New York romance.

title: King B.'s ROOST
description: Chicago Mafia Hit Man Alex Sims finds himself on the wrong end of the gun in this story about a hit man that gets hit by his own organization.

title: Planet B
description: France, 2039. One night, a group of activists pursued by the state vanish without a trace. Julia Bombarth is one of them. When she awakens, she finds herself trapped in an entirely unfamiliar world: PLANET B.

title: Wife in Apt C
description: When sports photographer Paul is temporarily confined to a wheelchair after a collision on the field with a linebacker, he thinks he will go crazy from boredom - until he catches a glimpse of the wife living in Apartment C across the way. With a parade of men coming in and out of her bedroom, and her shades wide open, Paul has a non-stop sex show right outside his window.

title: Fangs of Fortune
description: A powerful demon, tired of existence, embarks on a journey of rejuvenation instead of death. Chance encounters bring together a group of youths tracing a bloody path through the world.

title: Rebirth
description: During the Battle at the Frozen Lake, both Zhuge Yue and Chu Qiao fell into the icy waters. Chu Qiao was rescued by Yan Xun, only to learn that Zhuge Yue had perished; she subsequently sought an opportunity to assassinate Yan Xun to avenge Zhuge Yue. While in Bian Tang, Chu Qiao received repeated assistance from a mysterious man, someone who felt strangely familiar, leading her to suspect that Zhuge Yue might still be alive. Meanwhile, Yan Xun's actions grew increasingly extreme, plunging the four kingdoms into chaos. Ultimately, will Chu Qiao be able to restore peace to the realm, guide Yan Xun back from his misguided path, and reuniting with Zhuge Yue, help secure a better homeland for the people?

title: World War C
description: It's war. War against an invisible enemy that is not as deadly as we are told. The world is changing rapidly. Disproportionate measures are taken worldwide that disrupt society as a whole. A dichotomy in society forced vaccinations and restrictions on freedom. Have we had the worst? Or is there something more disturbing to awaiting us.

title: Whispers of Fate
description: Tang Li Ci, a recluse, gets entangled in a murder case and conspiracy to destroy the martial arts world, ten years after heroes slay cult leader Ye Mo.

title: Awaken the Infinite Money System
description: In a world where money buys magic, broke Kai Seldon is crushed by billionaire heir Andre Sterling, who owns the Guild and his mother's debt. With Raven’s scheme, Kai turns ledgers into weapons, forces a rematch, and watches a whole Arena pay for a miracle as Sterling's empire collapses. Left with real power, he learns what money can’t buy: the choice to become more is yours alone.

title: Option C
description: An up and coming actress gets her big break when she is diagnosed with cancer and finds herself up against the biggest fight of her life - With a corrupt system that will stop at nothing to bring her down, forcing her to play a role that she'd never thought she'd have to play.

title: Ro(c)k podvratáku
description: Group of young rock boys need money for their performing. Soo, they decide to rob big drug boss. Czech comedy.

title: Munnabhai S.S.C.
description: Munnbhai (Amit) has been repeating in SSC frequently.He is good at heart and sports but mischievous.Fed up with his daily tantrums his father throws him out of the house.

title: The Mysterious Miss C.
description: Mademoiselle C is a strange but touching woman. She, among others excentricities, talks to a small rock, Gertrude, like if she was alive. She is the supply teacher of the 6D, the worst group of St-Cécile Elementary School. When she arrives, Mademoiselle C, with her never ending imagination, will accomplish a true revolution in the elementary school and especially in the group 6D. This movie praise the right to be different and unique. It is also a movie about the happiness of reading and the power of imagination.

title: Spare Me, Great Lord! S1-S3
description: During the dawn of the magical era, Lü Shu, a metahuman, experiences the changes in himself, his country and the world.

title: Capital C
description: CAPITAL C is the first documentary about crowdfunding. It follows the hopes and dreams as well as the fears and pitfalls of a whole new generation of independent creators, who reach out to the crowd in order to change their lives forever.

title: The Romance of Tiger and Rose
description: A young screenwriter falls ill while working on a script and wakes up as one of her characters.

title: The Vanishing Beauty
description: Meng Yu, an only child from the Yangtze River Delta region and a popular online blogger, was considered a "lucky woman" envied by the people around her. On the occasion of her fifth wedding anniversary, however, her seemingly perfect and happy life crumbled. Not only did her marriage to her "model" husband begin to unravel, but she also faced numerous crises, including being exploited and financially drained by her in-laws. With the help of her friends, Meng Yu reevaluated her life and took back control of her destiny.

title: Joy of Life S1-S2
description: Fan Xian, born in the ancient empire of Southern Qing, inexplicably possesses memories from the 21st century. Wanting to learn about his mysterious past, he ventures to the capital, only to be entangled in the intrigues of the Emperor.

title: Temps Perdu, Regrets Laissés ( Doublé )
description: Léa Durand est en couple avec Gaston Martin, issu d'une famille riche. Lorsque Gaston a une maladie incurable, Léa est enceinte, et apprend la véritable identité de Gaston. Pour le sauver, elle le quitte délibérément. Elle donne naissance à leur fils Arthur. Cinq ans plus tard, Arthur a un accident de voiture. Léa fait appel à Gaston. La fiancée de Gaston complote pour faire mourir l'enfant, et rejette la faute sur Gaston. Le malentendu entre Gaston et Léa s'aggrave.

title: The Dragon King's Hot Valet is a runaway mommy
description: Five years ago, herbalist Cecilia slept with fire-poisoned Dragon King Evander and bore a half-dragon cub, Milo. To afford Milo's suppressant, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the king's manservant. Guarding her secret, she turns rival heiress Willow into a best friend. The king falls for his "male servant" and spirals into jealous self-doubt.

title: From His Surrogate to the Royal Princess
description: Adopted by the Leora family, Omega Eve is betrayed by her sister and her mate. To them, she's nothing more than a surrogate. When her ex comes crawling back, she shuts him down and chooses the ever-loyal Leonard.

title: Ruling Over All I See II: Path to Dominion(DUBBED)
description: Judah Shaw transmigrates into the ancient world, married to three wealthy wives. But before he gets to enjoy life, his second wife Willa Zorath gets abducted by Lotia Sect, who aims to have Judah surrender to them. Unwilling to yield, he defeats the sect leader and saves Willa, only to then be hunted by Ian Walton. But now bound with the sect leader's power, he easily reclaims safety—and starts a rebellion for justice.

title: My Unicorn Girl
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

title: The Missing Piece
description: After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. But when Shen Mo regains his memories, the six months they spent loving each other become completely erased. Desperate to keep Shen Mo by his side, Ji Mingxuan proposes a three-year ""contract lover"" arrangement. When two people are already in love, can a contract still keep their hearts in check?

title: Wasted Devotion, Rightful Love（DUBBED）
description: For ten years, Elena Hart loved Ethan Reed — until she catches him crossing lines with her comatose sister, Vivian Hart. Elena chooses to marry childhood protector Adrian Hale instead, but Ethan and Vivian retaliate, sabotaging her career. Fiercely protected by Adrian, Elena rises from ruin. title: Paranormal Highway
description: There are areas in the United States known for mysterious and unexplained phenomena, creating what are called paranormal hot spots. A team of investigators travels the country to experience and document these strange, unexplained events.

title: Fallen Princess, Rising Empress
description: After her kingdom falls, Princess Claire Rowan survives only to be handed to Regent Victor Bishop as a tool of humiliation. Burning with vengeance for her slain family, Claire uses her wit to navigate the royal court, quietly building her power to save her people. Victor's disdain slowly turns to love as he realizes she's the very woman who once saved his life.

title: Guess Who I Am [Hindi]
description: Song Yao who never misses a beat in punishing scumbags encounters the fake prince of Chengtian Group. Caught in a Smiths-like battle, the "unremarkable" girl with electrifying eyes and the liar "CEO" begin their story. Legend has it that there's such a person who makes rich scumbags quake in their boots because she never fails to make them suffer the consequences of their actions. This girl's name is Song Yao (Zhang Yuxi). It's all thanks to her fantastic assets in attracting the rich. Any person who is worth hundreds of millions will fall in love with her inextricably as long as he looks into her eyes. Yet no matter how powerful she is, there is a day when she will encounter her Waterloo. Song Yao's eyes fail to work on "Ji Chengchuan" who is the prince of Chengtian Group. Little does she know that this is entirely because the prince in front of him is an impostor named Qin Hao (Wang Ziqi). The meeting of the two "actors" is destined to be explosive.

description: To escape her father's gambling debts, Mia Parker agrees to pose as Victor Carter's cousin, whose grandmother is supposedly ill. Amid misunderstandings and schemes, secrets are revealed, rivals step aside, and Mia finds love with Victor.

title: The Wingless Dragon: Rise of Queen
description: An prophecy names Naira as the one to unite every dragon clan. But disappointingly, she is born without wings or dragon breath. As an infant, Naira is abandoned by her own father. Her mother sacrifices her power to save her—only to spend the next nineteen years in prison.Now, the forgotten princess returns, carrying the bloodline of the Ancient Black Dragon—to rescue her mother, expose the betrayal, punish the guilty, and claim her throne with frost and flame.

title: Dragon Lord's Reborn Contract Bride
description: Reborn after a brutal betrayal, Elven Princess Eileen vows revenge. She rejects the elite red dragon and chooses Kael, a broken-winged black dragon despised as a useless beast. Everyone mocks her, but on their forbidden wedding night, Eileen’s divine blood awakens Kael’s sealed dragon god core. The crippled beast everyone looked down upon reveals his true identity—the Sovereign Dragon King. Now, the ultimate vengeance begins.

title: Exiled to Emperor
description: Imperial Preceptor Hadrian Hale united Astoria, but after his betrayal by Empress Celia Vale, he was stripped of his titles and exiled. Escaping with 800 loyal guards, Hale crushed her assassins with ease. As enemies attacked from all sides, Hale rallied powerful factions—Northmarch, Huns, and more—defeating the Sunblessed Isle, Sunset Empire, Dragon Empire, and Sultanate of Tutan. He dismantled the Celestial Kingdom and wiped out the Primordia Sect, building an army of millions. Despite the Empress's arrogant attempts to humiliate him, Hale marched on the capital, using his immortal powers to subdue the Imperial Guards, crush her final resistance, and exile her. In the end, he claimed the throne and united the realm.
